title: Shotgun Sequencing of Tara Oceans Polar Circle DNA samples corresponding to size fractions for protists.
description: Analysis of the genes and genomes present in Tara Oceans Polar Circle protist size fractions through shotgun DNA sequencing. Seawater was filtered from different depths to retain small or large cell size (Protist organisms). The DNA was extracted and submitted to high throughput sequencing.
